title: Vesper and the Orbit
author: Edmund Hartwell
blurb: Gideon Zhou, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
